title: selfcheck fails allow-rules and hooks in a host project, on the kb's glab, core.hooksPath and .claude-plugin checks (second-project run)
goal: selfcheck in a host project checks only what that project's backlog.json and settings name: no FAIL for the kb's glab commands, core.hooksPath or a .claude-plugin/plugin.json the host does not have

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'selfcheck'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(1 if 'FAIL hooks' in o or 'FAIL allow-rules' in o else 0)

notes: Run finding 6: FAIL allow-rules: 6 of 31 not covered: git worktree add path -b branch origin/main, glab mr view code/ST-00000000 -F json, tool Agent +3 more; FAIL hooks: core.hooksPath is not set; .claude-plugin/plugin.json is missing or not JSON. Blocks the Nerthus workspace adoption (BG-42dg5ryi's host); raised to P1 by the operator. Not planned into a sprint: the fix needs an operator decision on an agents-rule path (_tools/bl_selfcheck.py). Ran the repro as filed: selfcheck on a fresh git-init project exits 1 with FAIL allow-rules (.claude/settings.json is missing) and FAIL hooks (core.hooksPath is not set; .claude-plugin/plugin.json is missing or not JSON), the stated defect, so it stays as filed. Open choices the goal leaves: (1) which setting gates each part of SKILL_COMMANDS (bl_selfcheck.py:77-105): the forge read by forge, the stale, eval and lint commands by land_stale, land_eval and land_lint, backlog.py merge by lane_module, the _tools/ paths by how a host runs the plugin, and whether the worktree command and the Agent and SendMessage tools stay required; (2) when the hooks check (hooks_problem, line 224, reads kg_hooks, the kb's own gate) and plugin_problem (line 245) apply: only when the project has a .githooks or a .claude-plugin/plugin.json, or by a settings key; (3) whether a missing .claude/settings.json is a FAIL or unknown in a project that names no steps. The rules in backlog.md (Dependencies) want a blocking operator gate before code on a bl_ module. Docs: backlog.md and tools.md (selfcheck row) map to bl_*.py and backlog.py. Next: add the gate with an option per choice, then plan touches (bl_selfcheck.py, bl_base.py if a setting is added, backlog.md, tools.md), depending on BG-c7pjl3mi and BG-cmvwrpbr.
